verdict.rationale: AMD's Instinct ecosystem documents Spur, an AI-native job scheduler that is drop-in compatible with Slurm and does GPU-first scheduling, so the job-scheduling axis applies and is partly covered. However, the evidence only lists Spur in a one-line docs entry and never mentions recurring or cron-style schedules or workflow orchestration. The GPU Operator for Kubernetes is only infrastructure enablement, not scheduling. Missing for 10: explicit recurring/periodic job scheduling, workflow/pipeline orchestration, in-depth Spur documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
